    • placePowderBlock

      public net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult placePowderBlock(net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem item, net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext placement)
      On the player-use path NeoForge arms block-snapshot capture around useOn and fires EntityPlaceEvent only after it returns, too late to prevent the powder debit. Capture is suspended for the vanilla placement so place() fires the event itself, as it does on the automation path, and a cancelled placement leaves the bucket undebited.
      Specified by:
      placePowderBlock in interface com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.platform.BucketOperations
